Overview
Explore how SAP Asset Performance Management (SAP APM) uses rich asset data to monitor equipment health, predict failures, and optimize asset reliability with the Internet of Things (IoT), analytics, and AI.
Asset master data
Quickly filter and select technical objects (such as equipment or functional locations) using integrated classification and organizational data from SAP Cloud ERP.
Extend business processes by incorporating measuring points, documents, and classification data from SAP Cloud ERP into SAP APM.
Model and manage complex systems as connected asset networks, providing visibility into how assets relate across enterprise-wide systems.
Ensure consistency and traceability with standardized designators that uniquely identify and retrieve system objects across documents and disciplines.
Create technical object groups from SAP Cloud ERP equipment and functional locations. Filter by classification, enrich with measuring points and documents, then run reliability and risk-based assessments.

Asset risk assessment
Keep your focus on what matters most by segmenting your assets based on risk and criticality.
Calculate standardized risk and criticality scores across impact categories using configurable scoring logic.
Drive your next actions by using an alphanumeric risk matrix to visualize and determine overall asset exposure across the portfolio.
Perform risk and criticality assessments on single or multiple assets, derive maintenance strategies from risk scores, and standardize results with templates and thresholds.
Define impact and likelihood of failure, then generate recommendations and next-best actions based on risk results.

Asset reliability engineering
Design maintenance and service strategies for critical assets using proven methods such as RCM (reliability-centered maintenance), FMEA (failure mode and effects analysis), and FMECA (failure modes, effects, and criticality analysis).
Analyze asset failure modes with structured FMEA to capture functions, document mechanisms and effects, and drive prioritized actions.
Turn recommendations into action items, including reactive and time-based strategies to condition-based, predictive, and prescriptive approaches.
Identify and prioritize the right maintenance or service actions by assessing promoted recommendations.
Implement recommendations and evaluate failure modes, causes, technical objects, and cost and risk impacts.
Streamline the transition from recommendations into execution workflows using harmonized master data.
Enable consistent governance across assets and teams by creating, tracking, and assessing reliability cases all in one place.
